text:
marta: thinking aloud — we should prototype a lightweight "token ownership checker" that ties an API key/service token back to org/project/service-account and shows recent routing/quotas. would be super helpful for support + billing :eyes:
chris: +1. high level UX: quick lookup by token id, show last 7 days of requests, top endpoints, assigned quota bucket, and current SLA tier. important: RBAC so only people with audit/access role can see provenance.
ian: question — do we want realtime introspection (authz call per request) or offline batch mapping? realtime = accurate but adds latency and cost.
tori: for lookup tool itself realtime makes sense, but for per-request path we should avoid extra synchronous calls. Could cache introspect results for 5m and keep a churn-safe KV.
sara: telemetry/privacy: mapping token->org is sensitive. we should TTL mappings (30d?) and redact any user PII in logs. Also need product/legal signoff for retention >90d.\marta: agree on TTL. proposed plan: 1) build a read-only dashboard in Console (admins only) that queries an internal service `GET /internal/tokens/{id}/ownership` which returns {owner_org, owner_project, sa, last_seen_ts, quotas}. response limited to minimal fields. 2) telemetry: emit anonymized routing tags to metrics (route_id, model_bucket) not token itself. 3) sampling: for heavy traffic, sample 1% of requests for full traces to link routing decisions to token types.
chris: implementation note: keep introspect endpoint cheap. Example response shape we want (pseudo):
```json
{
  "owner_org": "acme-corp",
  "owner_project": "acme-web",
  "service_account": "sa-ingest-1",
  "last_seen": 1712341200,
  "quota_bucket": "reserved-50k",
  "routing_hint": "dedicated-pool-us-west"
}
```
tori: for storage, prefer a time-series key-value with TTL (redis with eviction + write-through from auth-db). avoid long-running joins in the dashboard.
ian: rollout concerns: we should gate the dashboard behind a feature flag and initially only let SRE/support opt-in. Also add audit logging for every lookup (who asked for token->owner).
marta: UX detail: Console should surface a one-click "reassign" link for cases where a token was created under wrong project (but that action requires owner-admin). Also surface a "revoke" quick action that hits `POST /internal/tokens/{id}/revoke` and shows expected downstream impact on quotas.
sara: engineers — remember compliance: revokes must generate an immutable audit event stored in our compliance log for N days and copy to customer audit (if configured).
deploy-bot: campaign deploy started for feature/ownership-checker (canary: 10% infra) — build 3721 succeeded :party-parrot:
chris: follow-ups: estimate - backend prototype 2d, dashboard frontend 1d, small schema migration if we persist ownership snapshots ~3d total. I'll spin up a PR for the endpoints and a docs stub for console.
tori: ops question — sampling 1% for full traces sounds fine, but we should expose conf knob per environment. dev can be 10% to speed debugging.
ian: last thought — add a background job to reconcile token ownership weekly to detect orphaned tokens (no last_seen > 90d) and mark them as stale in the UI. good candidate for an automated email to customer-owned org owners.
marta: thanks everyone. I'll draft the RFC with the proposed API contract, retention defaults, and RBAC matrix. tagging @chris to lead the PR.
chris: on it. will add CI check to prevent exposing full token strings in dashboard logs.
